segments.sn44.9:1.1: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn44.9:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn44.9:2.1: “Purimāni, bho gotama, divasāni purimatarāni sambahulānaṃ nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kutūhalasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi –
segments.sn44.9:2.2: ‘ayaṃ kho pūraṇo kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
segments.sn44.9:2.3: Sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:2.5: Yopissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:3.1: “Ayampi kho makkhali gosālo … pe … ayampi kho nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto … pe … ayampi kho sañcayo [sañjayo (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] belaṭṭhaputto … pe … ayampi kho pakudho [pakuddho (pī.)] kaccāno … pe … ayampi kho ajito kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
segments.sn44.9:3.6: Sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:3.8: Yopissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:4.1: “Ayampi kho samaṇo gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
segments.sn44.9:4.2: Sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:4.4: Yopissa [yo ca khvassa (pī.)] sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto tañca sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālaṅkataṃ upapattīsu na byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:4.6: Api ca kho naṃ evaṃ byākaroti –
segments.sn44.9:4.7: ‘acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā’ti.
segments.sn44.9:4.8: Tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, ahu deva kaṅkhā, ahu vicikicchā –
segments.sn44.9:4.9: ‘kathaṃ nāma [kathañhi nāma (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.) kathaṃ kathaṃ nāma (chakkaṅguttare pañcamavagge dutiyasutte)] samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyo’”ti [dhammābhiññeyyāti (pī. ka.) dhammo … aññeyyo (chakkaṅguttare)]?
segments.sn44.9:5.2: Kaṅkhanīye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.
segments.sn44.9:5.3: Saupādānassa khvāhaṃ, vaccha, upapattiṃ paññāpemi no anupādānassa.
segments.sn44.9:5.4: Seyyathāpi, vaccha, aggi saupādāno jalati, no anupādāno;
segments.sn44.9:5.5: evameva khvāhaṃ, vaccha, saupādānassa upapattiṃ paññāpemi, no anupādānassā”ti.
segments.sn44.9:6.1: “Yasmiṃ, bho gotama, samaye acci vātena khittā dūrampi gacchati, imassa pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññāpetī”ti?
segments.sn44.9:6.2: “Yasmiṃ kho, vaccha, samaye acci vātena khittā dūrampi gacchati, tamahaṃ vātūpādānaṃ paññāpemi.
segments.sn44.9:6.3: Vāto hissa, vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.sn44.9:6.4: “Yasmiñca pana, bho gotama, samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti, imassa pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññāpetī”ti?
segments.sn44.9:6.5: “Yasmiṃ kho, vaccha, samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anupapanno hoti, tamahaṃ taṇhūpādānaṃ vadāmi.
segments.sn44.9:6.6: Taṇhā hissa, vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotī”ti [hotīti … pe …(ka.)].

lines: Navame kutūhalasālāyanti kutūhalasālā nāma paccekasālā natthi, yattha pana nānātitthiyā samaṇabrāhmaṇā nānāvidhaṃ kathaṃ pavattenti, sā bahūnaṃ “ayaṃ kiṃ vadati, ayaṃ kiṃ vadatī”ti kutūhaluppavattiṭṭhānato kutūhalasālāti vuccati.
Anupapanno hotīti cutikkhaṇeyeva paṭisandhicittassa anuppannattā anupapanno hoti.
Yāva ābhassarabrahmalokā gacchatīti agginā kappavuṭṭhānakāle gacchati, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Cuticittassa hi oraṃ sattarasamassa cittassa uppādakkhaṇe uppannaṃ kammajarūpaṃ cuticittena saddhiṃ nirujjhati, tato paraṃ kammajarūpaṃ na uppajjati.
Yadi uppajjeyya, maraṇaṃ na siyā, cuticittaṃ rūpaṃ na samuṭṭhāpeti, āhārajassa ca asambhavo eva, utujaṃ pana vattateva.
Yasmā paṭisandhikkhaṇe satto aññataraṇāya upapajjati nāma, cutikkhaṇe paṭisandhicittaṃ aladdhaṃ aññataraṇāya, tasmā vuttaṃ “cutikkhaṇe … pe … hotī”ti.
